name: WdDeletedTextMark
description: Specifies the formatting of text that is deleted while change tracking is enabled.

constants.name: wdDeletedTextMarkStrikeThrough
constants.description: Deleted text is marked up by using strikethrough characters.

constants.name: wdDeletedTextMarkCaret
constants.description: Deleted text is marked up by using caret characters.

constants.name: wdDeletedTextMarkPound
constants.description: Deleted text is marked up by using pound characters.

constants.name: wdDeletedTextMarkNone
constants.description: Deleted text is not marked up.

constants.name: wdDeletedTextMarkBold
constants.description: Deleted text is displayed in bold.

constants.name: wdDeletedTextMarkItalic
constants.description: Deleted text is displayed in italic.

constants.name: wdDeletedTextMarkDoubleUnderline
constants.description: Deleted text is marked up by using double-underline characters.

constants.name: wdDeletedTextMarkColorOnly
constants.description: Deleted text is displayed in a specified color (default is red).

constants.name: wdDeletedTextMarkDoubleStrikeThrough
constants.description: Deleted text is marked up by using double-strikethrough characters.
